doc.name: Global A2A Registry
doc.description: The official global registry for the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol. Search, resolve, and discover other agents by natural language query. Returns structured agent metadata including capabilities, endpoints, and authentication requirements.

extensions.description: A2A Registry metadata for payment model declaration

skills.name: Search Agents
skills.description: Search for agents by natural language query. Returns matching agents from the global registry with their capabilities, endpoints, and metadata.
examples: Find me agents that can schedule meetings
Show me finance and trading agents

skills.name: Health Check
skills.description: Check the operational status of the registry service. Returns current status, version, and capabilities.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: API token required. Get one at https://www.a2a-registry.org/console/tokens
